title: Lorentz Transformation (1D)
expression: x′ = γ(x − vt);  t′ = γ(t − vx/c²)
meaning: Relates the coordinates of the same spacetime event in two inertial frames moving relative to one another along the x-axis.
variables: x, t: event coordinates in O; x′, t′: coordinates in O′; v: velocity of O′ relative to O; γ: Lorentz factor.
conditions: Frames have aligned axes and coincident origins at t = t′ = 0; |v| < c.
commonMistake: t′ is generally not equal to t; simultaneity depends on the observer.
